title: Liberating LLM Capabilities in Full-Duplex Speech Models
abstract: arXiv:2606.07547v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Speech-based large language models are typically constrained to spoken replies, which limits their user-facing outputs to what can be verbalized and suppresses text-native capabilities such as code generation, structured analysis, and multi-step reasoning in realtime interaction, for tasks that require persistent, structured, and inspectable intermediate outputs. Existing work improves spoken reasoning or full-duplex turn-taking, but still treats text as a hidden intermediate state or a subordinate modality rather than a first-class output channel. We propose Listen-Write-Speak (LWS), a text-first tri-channel paradigm in which a single autoregressive LLM continuously listens to user audio, writes visible free-form text as its primary output, and speaks a realtime oral response in parallel under a shared causal attention context. translated_title: 在全双工语音模型中释放大语言模型的能力
translated_abstract: 基于语音的大语言模型通常局限于口头回复，这将其面向用户的输出限制在可言语表达的内容上，抑制了代码生成、结构化分析和多步推理等文本原生能力在实时交互中的应用，而这些能力对于需要持久、结构化且可检查中间输出的任务至关重要。现有工作改进了口语推理或全双工轮次交互，但仍将文本视为隐藏的中间状态或从属模态，而非一流的输出通道。我们提出“听-写-说”（Listen-Write-Speak，LWS），这是一种文本优先的三通道范式：单个自回归大语言模型在共享因果注意力上下文下，持续监听用户音频，将可见的自由格式文本作为主要输出进行书写，并同时说出实时的口头回应。该行为完全通过Token Schema实现，无需任何架构修改。
tldr: 提出“听-写-说”（LWS）文本优先三通道范式，让单个自回归大语言模型在全双工语音交互中同时持续监听用户语音、以可见文本为主要输出并实时进行语音回应，从而无需架构修改即可释放代码生成等文本原生能力。
en_tdlr: Proposes Listen-Write-Speak (LWS), a text-first tri-channel paradigm where a single autoregressive LLM continuously listens to user audio, writes visible free-form text as its primary output, and speaks real-time oral responses in parallel, liberating text-native capabilities in full-duplex speech models without architectural modification.
